book.title: ME IBELIU ꞌIDI LETA YESU MANUNA

content: Totaliya Melikisedeki

Ta Melikisedeki nina me Salema ꞌidi kini, ta Yaubada Toloetana sana ꞌina totaliya. Lowaenei Melikisedeki nina Ebelaamo ꞌilobena, tuta nina losaiya ꞌenega ꞌiilailama. Ta Ebelaamo nina toloinao yaudi ma ꞌadi bodao niꞌatu ꞌipeꞌudi, ꞌenega Melikisedeki Ebelaamo ꞌiona obobomena.

ꞌEnega Ebelaamo ꞌina gwegweyao ꞌiweyalidi egueguyai sanau ꞌadi yau, ga egueguyai ꞌebweuna Melikisedeki ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena, ta Ebelaamo tauna naini ꞌiꞌewedi. Ta Melikisedeki ꞌana esana ꞌana gibui “Toloina palupaluna,” ta ꞌina sena ꞌana esana Salema, ꞌana gibui “Siwalowa,” ꞌenega tamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene Melikisedeki tauna ina loina siwasiwalowina.

Ta Melikisedeki nina nigeya tamanamo ta nigeya sinanamo, ta wate nigeya ꞌina susumo, ta ꞌina tubuwa be ꞌina mwawasa nigeya ꞌadi mwalatoimo, ta esi ꞌatuwa nadigega Yaubada natuna ꞌietotaliya ataya Yaubada ꞌenaya.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Melikisedeki nina ꞌebweu ꞌinapwana ta toloetana sana, ga Ebelaamo ꞌiloetana sinena, ta Ebelaamo ꞌina gwegwe ꞌenega tupwana ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena Melikisedeki.

Ta totaliyao taudi Libai ꞌina bodao ꞌidi gwegwe tupwana siꞌewaꞌewa ꞌaboꞌada Ebelaamo tubunao ꞌedega, manuna taudi be ꞌaboꞌada susu ꞌebweuna, ta wate ma ꞌadi loina gwegwe ꞌana ꞌewa tomota ꞌediyega manuna.

Ta Melikisedeki mali susu, ta ꞌina miya loetana namo, ꞌenega gwegwe tupwana ꞌiꞌewena Ebelaamo ꞌenega. ꞌEnega wate Melikisedeki ꞌina ona oboboma Ebelaamo ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena. Ebelaamo nina tai sinabwana, manuna Yaubada ꞌina onaupaupa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena,

ta Melikisedeki Ebelaamo ꞌiloetana sinena, manuna tuta yauna taudi ꞌadi esana sinabwadi ꞌidi ona oboboma siꞌebwaꞌebwaya tomota taudi ꞌadi esana gidalidi ꞌediya, ꞌadi lema manuna, ꞌenega wanuwaꞌiꞌisi ꞌaene Melikisedeki ꞌina ona oboboma Ebelaamo ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena.
Gete tugai Libai ꞌina bodao ꞌida gwegwe tupwana siꞌewaꞌewa, ta taudi maꞌetamo simwamwawasa, ta Melikisedeki tetelina ꞌaene tauna miyamiya atayana.
Batuwa ꞌida gwegwe ꞌana tupwa taꞌebwaꞌebwaya Libai tubunao ꞌediya, ta lowa ꞌana ꞌita ꞌatuwa Melikisedeki nina gwegwe ꞌana tupwa ꞌiꞌewena Libai ꞌenega,
manuna Libai maꞌetamo tubuna Ebelaamo solanaya, ta Ebelaamo Melikisedeki ꞌedaya ꞌilobena, ga ꞌina gwegwe ꞌana tupwa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena.

Libai tubunao taudi ꞌidi guinuwa Yaubada ꞌina loinao me Isileli sieꞌitada, ta loina nina nigeya sawesawenaya ꞌigiepalu ꞌaiꞌailida, ꞌenega nuwanuwada ꞌebweu totaliya auwauna be ꞌigiepaluda. Totaliya nina nadigega Melikisedeki, ta nigeya Eloni matubunao nadigega.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma totaliya tasaꞌu gelasedi loina wate tasaꞌu gelasedi.
Tamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene Keliso tauna ꞌida totaliya auwauna, nigeya Libai ꞌina susu ꞌenega ꞌimeema,
ta esi Yuda ꞌina susu ꞌenega ꞌimai, taudi nigeya esinuwa silobaloba Mosese ꞌenega be sietotaliya.
ꞌEnega ꞌida totaliya auwauna Melikisedeki nadigega.
Nigeya Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌenega ꞌietotaliya, ta esi yawasina miyamiya atayana ta waiwaina ꞌenega.
Tauna Yesu manuna Buki Tabu ꞌigwae, “ꞌOyo ꞌuetotaliya ataya, nadigega Melikisedeki.”

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Mosese ꞌina loinao nigeya sawesawediya be ꞌebweu toꞌase sigiepalu ꞌaiꞌaili. ꞌEnega gimi loina tapilisinena, manuna nenetana, ta ꞌenega emisa auwauna ta boboꞌana ꞌiapwesama, be emisa nina ꞌenega Yaubada taloselabe.
Ta ꞌaboꞌada ꞌida emisa Keliso ꞌena ꞌimiyami. Ta Yaubada Keliso nina lowa ꞌiona obobomena.
Gimi totaliyao nigeya Yaubada ꞌina ona oboboma silobaloba. Ta Yesu namo manuna ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana niꞌatu ꞌiona upaupa be ꞌoyo ꞌuetotaliya ataya, ta onaupaupa gete geyaꞌabo ꞌiligeligei.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina loina auwauna tamwalatoi ꞌaiꞌailina ꞌaene loina kadekadelina ꞌiboboꞌana sinena.
Lowa gimi totaliyao mali ꞌepata be mali ꞌepata ꞌediya ma ꞌadi boda be ꞌaidi simwawamwawasa, ta auwaudi sieelopaꞌeludi.
Ta Yesu tauna ꞌida totaliya ataya, ꞌenega nigeya ꞌana lopaꞌelumo.
Ta Yesu nina tuta maiboꞌana sawesawenaya ꞌiꞌetoseyeda, ꞌeguma ꞌana emisega talulugu Yaubada matanaya, manuna Yesu miyamiya atayana, ta tuta yauna manuda ꞌisidasida Yaubada ꞌena.

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yesu nina sawesawenaya be ꞌietotaliya manuda, manuna tauna adelina maiboꞌana boboꞌana tuga, ta nigeya nadigega totoꞌumalida ꞌaboꞌada, ꞌenega Yaubada Yesu nina ꞌigilagasina, ga galewa ꞌana tomiyanao ꞌiloetana sinedi.

Ta gimi totaliyao ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna Yaubada ꞌena sitalitaliya, taudi ꞌidi toꞌumalinao, ta tomota wate ꞌidi toꞌumalinao manudi. Ta Yesu maꞌebweuna namo oona ꞌitagwalena ga ꞌitaliyaena Yaubada ꞌena manuda.
ꞌEpata nuganuganidi ꞌediya Mosese ꞌina loinega tomota mayaluyaluwa nenetadi sietotaliya sinabwana, ta muliyega Yaubada ꞌina onaupaupa ꞌenega Natuna tauna adelina palupaluna ꞌietotaliya ataya.
